svg.title: Scanner · Quickhacks — CyberFinger controls
svg.desc: Shared. Left Stick: Push fully up/down to page quickhacks. Shared. Right Trigger: Apply selected quickhack. Shared. Left Grip: Toggle scanner. With the default left movement stick, use your right Trigger to confirm the hack.
svg.text: With the default left movement stick, use your right Trigger to confirm the hack.
